data.title: Westwood Grande
data.about:
Westwood Grande by Imtiaz is a sophisticated residential project located in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities. This contemporary development offers stylish studio and 1-bedroom apartments designed to meet the needs of modern urban living. Completed in 2024, the building’s eye-catching façade and refined interiors make it a standout in the JVC skyline.

Built by the award-winning Imtiaz Developments, Westwood Grande combines luxury, convenience, and technology in every detail. Each apartment comes fully furnished with smart home features, offering residents a seamless living experience. From rooftop leisure spaces to elegant interiors, Imtiaz Westwood Grande at JVC delivers both comfort and lifestyle in one complete package.

characteristics_module.title: Westwood Grande JVC by Imtiaz - Elegant Living with a Smart Edge in Dubai
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Location Advantage – Situated in JVC with easy access to E311 and Al Khail Road.
  • Fully Furnished Units – Move-in ready homes with premium finishes and furniture included.
  • Smart Home Technology – Alexa-enabled automation with smart locks, lighting, and A/C control.
  • Five-Star Amenities – Rooftop pool, gym, garden, BBQ, and kids' play area for leisure and wellness.
  • Developer Excellence – Brought to life by Imtiaz Developments with over 28 years of expertise.
  • High ROI Potential – An appealing investment choice in a high-demand, family-centric community.
  • Attractive Pricing – Exceptional value with a competitive entry point for luxury living.
  • Premium Bosch Appliances – Equipped with durable, high-end appliances for everyday ease.

location_tile.title: Prime JVC Location with Excellent Connectivity
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Westwood Grande by Imtiaz is located in Jumeirah Village Circle, one of Dubai’s most family-friendly communities. Known for its tranquil environment and community-centric design, JVC offers excellent connectivity via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Al Khail Road (E44). Westwood Grande at Jumeirah Village Circle enjoys proximity to schools, parks, retail outlets, and dining venues—making it ideal for residents.

  • 5 Minutes – Circle Mall
  • 7 Minutes – Dubai Sports City
  • 13 Minutes – Dubai Butterfly Garden
  • 20 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
  • 25 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
